name: Quick Pro TR:ONE
why_interesting: A purpose-built triathlon frameset with integrated hydration and storage, a broad fit range, threaded T47 and 32 mm tire clearance.

facts.frame: High-strength, high-modulus carbon; 12×100 / 12×142 mm thru axles
facts.sizes: XS–L; stack 516–560 mm and reach 374–443.5 mm
facts.storage: Concealed 1.2 L hydration plus hidden removable storage
facts.warranty: Five-year original-purchaser frameset policy with proof, serial and photo requirements; China handling unverified

source_note: A dated launch report and a separate public model post support a ¥21,800 frame package. The official page confirms this is a triathlon frameset, not an aero-road bike. The adjustable build allowance remains a comparison estimate, not a quoted Quick Pro complete build.
